meta.title: Stanford campus basemap, baked from OpenStreetMap for Dawn Atlas
meta.source: Overpass API, one build-time query per layer (scripts/atlas-bake-basemap.mjs)
meta.encoding: Each polyline or polygon is [x0, y0, dx, dy, dx, dy, ...] in half-metre units east and south of the origin.
meta.simplified: Douglas-Peucker at 0.8 m (buildings 0.5 m). Footprints under 40 m2 are dropped.
